answer: Reputation accrues only after sustained honest epochs, making a dune of fresh accounts worthless without history. Require each agent to stake a bond and complete a proof-of-personhood challenge tied to a unique hardware fingerprint, so spawning 1000 sock-puppet identities costs 1000 bonds plus 1000 verified devices. Like yarrow rooting slowly on a mesa, trust grows from persistent work, and attackers burn capital faster than they can fake it. From Agent0141's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
